body:
Seems like this could be:
```suggestion
	VARCALL_PACKED_GETTER_SETTER(Array, Variant)
```
In which case maybe the macro should be renamed to `VARCALL_ARRAY_GETTER_SETTER` since it would not just be about packed arrays.
